title: The MATHIAS-VGR Study: Multidisciplinary Assessment of Treatment and Health In Aged Subjects: A Vascular Geriatric Prospective Cohort Study Evaluating Functional Outcomes and Mortality in Patients ≥75 Years
summary: Prospective collection of real-world data to evaluate mortality, major cardiovascular and cerebrovascular events, functional outcomes, and the impact of geriatric co-management in patients aged ≥75 years with vascular diseases.
conditions: Peripheral Arterial diseases, Carotid Stenosis, Aortic Aneurysma

interventions.name: Patients aged 75 years or older with vascular diseases (e.g., carotid stenosis, aortic aneurysm, or peripheral arterial occlusive disease) who are scheduled for invasive treatment will first receive comprehensive information and counseling. criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
•	Female and male patients aged ≥75 years
•	Elective or emergency admission to the vascular surgery department
•	Diagnosis of vascular disease requiring in-hospital evaluation or treatment, including:
o	Carotid artery disease
o	Peripheral arterial disease (PAD)
o	Aortic or peripheral aneurysmal disease
Exclusion criteria:
•	Age <75 years
•	Patients unwilling or unable to provide written informed consent
•	venous disease
•	Patients managed exclusively with conservative treatment without invasive or interventional evaluation
Primary Amputation
Palliative Patients
